title: art of rally
notes: Experimental native Linux custom-rally integration. V8 uses shared inputs and thinking DeepSeek/Jev live and frozen cohorts. Delivery freezes the reviewed configuration and preserves native scoring, ordered stages and model-specific death handling without requiring a prior complete rally victory. On 2026-10-26 the owner approved the actual V7 settings: normal AI, existing assists and effective CUSTOM damage 0 (disabled), confirmed by native readback, to keep the baseline vehicle, assists and environment consistent while evaluating discrete keyboard route completion. The owner retained the 2 m full-segment coverage rule after a 13/100 thinking calibration and accepted documented transition timing and host-clock limitations. Unobserved native terminal paths are not claimed as qualified. The earlier medium-damage description was a menu-default mismatch. Historical V5-V7 and development assessments remain separate. No human-reference speed milestones; game-specific pilot rubric.
introduction: A top-down rally driving game. The run opens at the beginning of a custom rally. Driving stages alternate with result and continuation screens, ending at the final rally result.
controls: W is throttle, S is brake/reverse, A and D steer left and right, and Space is the handbrake. Enter confirms the displayed menu or result selection. The car uses automatic transmission. The driving-only preparation disables in-race pause, manual recovery and restart; automatic recovery and result navigation remain available.
